name: 30_place_hammer_on_basket
title: Organizing Tabletop and Covering Items
summary: The robot places a hammer and banana on a basket while temporarily covering a medicine box with a cloth.
robot: one white arm with a parallel gripper
setting: tabletop with a woven basket and assorted small items

source.original_prompt: pick up the hammer and place it on the basket

segments.instruction: Reach down and grasp the toy hammer on the table; the camera remains stationary.
Lift the hammer and place it on top of the basket; the camera remains stationary.
Move to the front of the basket and pick up the blue cloth; the camera remains stationary.
Drape the blue cloth completely over the medicine box on the right; the camera remains stationary.
segments.memory_event: hide: medicine box covered completely by the blue cloth

segments.instruction: Move to the center and grasp the banana; the camera remains stationary.
Lift the banana and set it beside the hammer on top of the basket; the camera remains stationary.
Lift the blue cloth to uncover what was covered; the camera remains stationary.
segments.memory_event: return: medicine box reappears upright in its original position

segments.instruction: Place the cloth back onto the table in front of the basket and retract upward; the camera remains stationary.
